bull.b: A richer mix and stronger acceptance of higher-end models can lift economics beyond unit growth, while revenue continued to expand year over year. This supports a more durable premiumization strategy if Zepp broadens T-Rex, Balance and Active tiers without weakening demand.

Sequential value-share gains across major regions indicate improving brand reach rather than reliance on one geography. A broader installed base can strengthen distribution, support ecosystem adoption and create more opportunities to monetize related software and services over time.

The exclusive global partnership provides a multi-year channel for athlete-led credibility and product integration across training and recovery. It can deepen engagement with performance-focused users while reinforcing Amazfit’s strategic positioning in the growing hybrid-training category.

bear.b: The latest quarter still produced a substantial net loss despite stronger revenue and gross margin. Persistent losses reduce internally generated funding and make the planned profitable-growth transition dependent on successful execution, cost control and continued demand.

Weak internal cash generation alongside rising leverage can constrain investment flexibility and increase reliance on balance-sheet support while losses continue. This combination leaves less financial capacity to absorb setbacks or fund product and technology investment independently.

Memory inflation can compress hardware margins if component costs rise faster than Zepp can adjust prices or product specifications. Because wearables depend on competitive pricing and frequent launches, sustained cost pressure could slow the path from improved gross margin to profitability.
